text: Long catch-up with Delroy. His dad's had a minor stroke and is in the Royal until at least Friday. Delroy's driving up and down every day and looks shattered. His sister Petra is coming down from Glasgow on the 26th to take over for a few days, which should help. Delroy's own anniversary with Chantal is 2nd of November and he says he's forgotten all about it. Need to drop round with some food this weekend.
Chen and Ines got engaged in Lisbon! Wedding pencilled for 14 May 2027. Ines wants something small, Chen's mum wants 200 guests, so that should be fun.

Sofia's redundancy meeting is on 3rd of November. She's trying to stay positive but admitted she hasn't slept properly in a week. Her partner Rory reckons she'll get a decent package. She's also meant to be going to her cousin's wedding in Bristol on the 8th and doesn't feel like celebrating at all. She asked me to keep it quiet at work for now. Text her the night before.
Rana's nan passed away on Sunday. Funeral is 28/10 at St Mary's, 11am. Don't forget to send a card to her and her mum.
Eamon finally back on his feet after the knee op. Physio twice a week till Christmas. Still can't drive, so Sean is ferrying him about. He seemed in good spirits honestly.
Wiremu and Nora's 10th anniversary is 2 November 2026. Nora dropped a massive hint about the Ottolenghi cookbook. He's planning a weekend in the Lakes but it's a surprise.
Arturo and Zainab have split up. Amicable apparently, but Arturo's moving out end of the month and is clearly gutted. Check in on him next week.
Petra's little boy Felix has had tonsillitis on and off since September. Seeing an ENT consultant on 12 Dec. She's worn out, poor thing.

Amir got made redundant Friday. Thirty people gone in one go. He's already applying for stuff and sounded oddly upbeat. Wife's due in March 2027 though so the timing is awful. His boss told him the package is three months' pay. He's got a second interview at Kumar & Osei on 30/10, which he's nervous about. Wish him luck on the Wednesday.
Chioma's wedding is 7th of June next year in Lagos. Save the date coming. Must sort passport renewal before Christmas.
Quick one: Joe's mum had a fall, broke her wrist. She's ok, just fed up. Joe sounded rattled.

Gabriel and Laila celebrating 25 years on 19/11. Party at the cricket club Saturday the 22nd, I'm bringing the cake. Their daughter Hana is organising. Laila had a mastectomy last spring and this is the first big thing they've done since, so it means a lot. Gabriel asked everyone to bring an old photo for a board. Dig out the one from Hana's christening.
Elijah's dad died last week, very sudden. Cremation is private but there's a memorial at the pub on the 8th of November. Elijah's sister Heather flying back from Sydney for it. I'll go with Reza.
Chantal broke up with her fiancé. Wedding's off, obviously. She's staying with Bethany for a bit. Remind me to ring her on Thursday.
Rory has glandular fever, off uni for at least three weeks. His mum is keeping him at home.
Eva says Stefan proposed on the beach in Crete on 30 September. Ring was his grandmother's. Need to send them a card and maybe a bottle of something.

Ilse's chemo starts 4 November 2026. Six rounds, three weeks apart. She's nervous but very matter of fact about it. Her husband Wei has taken leave. I said I'd do Tuesday school runs for their two. Their eldest, Hana, has her GCSE mocks in December so she's stressed as well. Must check the dates with Wei and put them in the calendar.
Sophie got the all clear!! Scan results came back Monday. Celebratory dinner at hers on the 15th.
Hana's anniversary w Delroy is 3rd December, five years. She wants to redo their first date, the curry house on Mill Road.
Called Sean. His brother Eamon is in hospital with pneumonia, oxygen and everything. They're hoping he's home by 1 Nov. Sean's holding it together but only just.
Dentist moved to 21/10 at 9.20. Then pick up dry cleaning.
Nora and Wiremu went to the vet with Biscuit, their old labrador. Lump on his leg, biopsy results due next Tuesday. Nora's in bits about it.
Bumped into Mrs Walsh at the shop. Her husband's funeral was last Thursday and she said the turnout was lovely. Should pop round with flowers.

Zainab's sister Laila is getting married 16 August 2027 in Bradford. Zainab is maid of honour and already stressing about the hen do. She loves anything Bake Off. Their dad's been poorly with his chest all autumn too, so she's juggling a lot. The engagement party is 23rd of November at their aunt's. Get Zainab a little good luck thing for the hen, maybe a Bake Off apron.

Did the hospital drive with Arturo today. His mum's hip replacement went fine, she's home Monday. Arturo's taking the whole week off to look after her. His sister Sofia is coming from Madrid on 3 November 2026 to take the second week. Their mum is apparently already bossing the nurses about. Follow up Wednesday to see how she's getting on.
Felix Nowak from work lost his job when the Leeds office shut. He's going freelance. Seems fine about it but I know money's tight with the new mortgage.
Text Chioma good luck for the redundancy consultation on Thursday.

Bethany's dad has early onset dementia, diagnosed in the summer. She's going part time from January 2027 to help her mum. Heavy chat. Her brother Rory lives in Canada so it's all falling on her. They've applied for a care assessment, decision due 14/11. She likes gardening, maybe some bulbs as a little pick-me-up.
Chen messaged, his grandad passed away in Guangzhou. He's flying out 25 Oct for two weeks. Ines is staying here with the kids.

Catch-up w Reza and Gabriel at the pub. Reza's wife Sophie is pregnant, due 3 April 2027, first one. Gabriel's mum is in hospital again with her heart, third time this year. He's trying to get compassionate leave sorted. Reza's buzzing, Gabriel very quiet. Need to message Gabriel tomorrow just to see how he is.
Petra mentioned her and Amir's wedding anniversary is 9 Nov, they're doing nothing this year because money is tight after his redundancy.
Heather - big news. Engaged to Stefan as of last night. No date yet, thinking spring 2028. She's vegan so remember that for any engagement drinks.
Wei's daughter broke her arm on the trampoline. Cast on for six weeks, so no swimming gala on 2nd of November. Wei's feeling guilty.
My cousin's wedding 13th Dec, need to RSVP by Friday and book the Travelodge.

Sofia (Sof) and Rory had their civil ceremony on Saturday. Tiny, just family. They're having a proper party in the summer, July 2027 probably. Get them a gift, they mentioned wanting a decent coffee machine.
Ines is struggling. Her divorce was finalised on 6 October and her mum's ill. She said she's fine but she clearly isn't. Must take her for lunch soon.
Eamon's dog Pepper went missing over the weekend, found her Monday in a neighbour's shed. Eamon is mostly just relieved.
Elijah has his tribunal for the unfair dismissal on 17 Nov 2026. He's anxious, got a solicitor through the union. Message him that morning.
Spoke to Uncle Delroy. Auntie's back from hospital after the gallbladder op. He's doing all the cooking now which nobody is thrilled about lol.

Had a proper long chat with Laila last night, first in ages. Her and Joe have separated, he moved out in August. The kids are coping ok, the eldest less so. She's thinking of moving back to Leicester near her parents in spring 2027. Her mum's had a couple of falls too, which is part of it. Joe apparently has a new girlfriend already. Need to check in on her in a couple of weeks and maybe invite her and the kids for Sunday lunch.
Amir's dad's 70th is 30/11 and there's a do at the Indian place. Amir's dad isn't well though so it might be cut short.
Rana's wedding anniversary dinner on Friday was cancelled because her husband got Covid. Rescheduled to 1st Nov.

Notes from coffee with Chantal: she got made redundant in June, now loves her new job at the council. Her brother Rory is getting married 20 September 2027 in Dublin. She's maid of honour. Wants a hand with the speech.
Hana's mum had a scan Tuesday, waiting on results. Don't mention it unless she brings it up.
Stefan back at work after his breakdown in the summer. Doing three days a week until 1 Dec, then full time. He's into bouldering now, says it helps.
Gabriel said his grandmother's funeral is 31 October, Friday. He'd like company, so I'm going with him. Remind me to iron the black suit.
Nora mentioned it'd be her and Wiremu's wedding day 12/12 but they're having a quiet one. She'd love one of those personalised star maps.
Ilse mentioned Wei's first chemo went ok, bit sick after. Next round 25 Nov.
Eva and her girlfriend Petra broke up. Eva's moving into her brother Sean's spare room from 1st December. She doesn't want to talk about it much.
Buy a sympathy card and stamps tomorrow. Bins out tonight.
Joe's daughter Bethany has been in and out of A&E with asthma. They've got a respiratory clinic appt on 4 Dec 2026. Joe and his wife are both exhausted. Ask him how the clinic went.
Reza and his husband Felix renewing vows in Marrakech, March 2027. They've invited loads of people. Reza wants us all to wear white.
Sophie's brother Chen got laid off in the latest round at the bank. Chen's okay but Sophie's worried about him. She says he's cooking a lot, which is his coping thing.
Zainab's cat Momo had to be put to sleep on Saturday. She's devastated, had him 16 years. Should send her something small.
Heather Brennan (everyone calls her Hev) - recovering from a burst appendix, back home since 10/10. Off work until 3 November 2026. Her partner Wiremu's taken over the school runs.
Arturo's parents' ruby anniversary is 18th of January. He's organising a family meal and asked if I'd do a slideshow. Need photos from him by Christmas.
Sean's mum died on 2 October. Funeral was lovely. He's back at work but says the evenings are hard. Will ring him on Sunday, and every few weeks after.
Chioma's son has chickenpox, so they're missing her sister's engagement party on Saturday. She's gutted.
Laila told me Gabriel's wife left him in September. He hasn't really told people. Seems to be throwing himself into marathon training.
Delroy and Chantal married 8 June 2024, so second anniversary was this summer. Missed it. Next year 8/6 set a reminder.
